cards.title: Regulars are built, not discounted
cards.body: A patient who trusts you comes back for years. Here are five ways to earn that without getting into a price war.

cards.title: Remember the person
cards.body: Ask how Mummy's knee is doing. People come back to someone who remembers them, not just their order.

cards.title: Explain the dose clearly
cards.body: A quick line on timing and food makes patients feel looked after. If the counter is busy, write it on the box.

cards.title: Keep their regulars in stock
cards.body: Note who takes what long-term. Running out of someone's BP medicine sends them to the shop down the road.

cards.title: Remind before they run out
cards.body: A simple refill reminder by call or message brings patients back right when they need you.

cards.title: Be the one they can call
cards.body: Answering a small question over the phone builds more loyalty than any discount.

cards.title: Trust is the real loyalty card
cards.body: Care, clarity and reliability keep patients coming back. AICA is building refill predictions for pharmacies, free for founding pharmacies during the Lucknow pilot.

takeaway: Chemists keep patients by remembering them, explaining doses, stocking their regulars, reminding about refills and being reachable.
share: Forward this to the chemist you've been going to for years.
